Private Sub Edit(ByVal which As Long, c As Object, r As Variant)
    Select Case which
    Case 1: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "P": c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Font.Size = 12: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Font.Size
    Case 2: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Font.Size = 12: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "P": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 3: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Font.Size = 12: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Font.Size
    Case 4: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "P": c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Font.Bold = True: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Font.Bold
    Case 5: c.ChartType = xlArea: r = c.ChartType
    Case 6: c.ChartType = xlAreaStacked: r = c.ChartType
    Case 7: c.ChartType = xlPie: r = c.ChartType
    Case 8: c.ChartType = xlDoughnut: r = c.ChartType
    Case 9: c.ChartType = xlArea: c.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: r = c.ChartType
    Case 10: c.SeriesCollection(2).ChartType = xlLine: r = c.SeriesCollection(2).ChartType
    Case 11: c.SeriesCollection(2).ChartType = xlLineMarkers: r = c.SeriesCollection(2).ChartType
    End Select
End Sub

Private Function Finish(wb As Workbook, c As Object, ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim r As Variant, s As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Edit which, c, r
    s = Err.Number & " " & TypeName(r) & " " & r
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    wb.Close False
    Finish = s
End Function

Public Function Loaded(ByVal path As String, ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Loaded = Finish(wb, wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart, out, which)
End Function

Public Function Fresh(ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, c As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "One"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
    Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart
    c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
    Fresh = Finish(wb, c, out, which)
End Function
